definitions.ask: Should the installer offer to unlock a locked login keychain when the stable identity exists?
definitions.why: SSH/tmux installs work after one password prompt and keep the stable signature and grant

choices.label: Prompts via security unlock-keychain in a terminal, then retries; otherwise stops with exit 77
Never prompts; always stops before building with exit 77 and the fixes
Falls back to ad-hoc with a warning; the Accessibility grant resets on that install
